components.notes: Django test runner with NETBOX_CONFIGURATION=netbox.configuration_testing; needs PostgreSQL (netbox/netbox on localhost:5432) and Redis on localhost:6379, as CI's service containers provide. CI also runs makemigrations --check and collectstatic before tests, and swaps psycopg[c] for psycopg[binary] on non-release runs.
Yarn 1 workspace for the TypeScript/SCSS frontend; CI's Frontend job runs yarn validate (tsc --noEmit, eslint, prettier check) and scripts/verify-bundles.sh, which passed. It has no test suite.

Committed esbuild output bundles, checked by scripts/verify-bundles.sh.
